verdict.rationale: Jeeves Cash documents multi-currency accounts earning up to 5% yield, so idle cash can earn interest. The evidence shows no dedicated savings sub-account or reserve bucket, and no automated sweep or transfer rules for building a cushion. Scheduled payments and manual FX conversion between currency accounts are adjacent features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: dedicated high-yield savings/reserve sub-account, automated transfer or sweep rules, yield terms detail, independent corroboration.
